trends.name: Iran War De-escalation & Oil Shock
trends.summary: Trump signaling willingness to end Iran conflict within 4-6 weeks without reopening Hormuz Strait, creating major oil market volatility (+$50/barrel from December lows). Geopolitical risk premium unwinding but uncertainty persists on long-term energy prices and global recession fears (37% probability by end-2026 per Polymarket).

trends.name: Recession Risk & Market Correction
trends.summary: Market sentiment deeply pessimistic with SPY down 7.1% YTD, Russell 3000 median short interest at 4.3% (15-year high, above 2022 bear market levels), and Polymarket pricing 37% recession probability. US equities underperforming historical geopolitical shock recoveries with significant downside risk remaining.

trends.name: China Economic Recovery Accelerates
trends.summary: China's manufacturing PMI jumped to 50.4 (beat est. 50.1), non-manufacturing at 50.1, and composite PMI at 50.5, marking sharp acceleration from prior month. Factory activity returns to growth at fastest pace in a year, signaling stabilization in world's second-largest economy and potential easing of deflation concerns.

trends.name: Semiconductor Sector Weakness vs. Software
trends.summary: Software outperformed semiconductors by 500+ basis points today (rare occurrence), driven by Micron's 10% post-earnings crash and broader chip sector pullback. Signals deteriorating semiconductor demand outlook and potential rotation away from AI-heavy hardware plays, contrasting with resilient software valuations.

trends.name: Energy & Infrastructure M&A Wave
trends.summary: Sysco acquiring Restaurant Depot for $29 billion expansion into high-margin cash & carry channel, alongside broader capital deployment activity. Reflects confidence in essential services and logistics infrastructure despite macro headwinds, though energy sector shorts elevated amid geopolitical flux.

trends.name: Japan Equity Peak Reversal & Yen Weakness
trends.summary: Japan's Topix surrendered almost all +15% February highs amid retail sales collapse (Feb: -2.0% M/M vs. est. -0.9%), though Topix still outperforms SPX by +10%. Asian currencies weakening on rising oil prices and recession fears; Japan's growth narrative deteriorating despite relative outperformance.

trends.name: Unilever & Consumer Sector Cost Pressures
trends.summary: Unilever initiating global 3-month hiring freeze, signaling cost-cutting across consumer staples amid macro headwinds. Coupled with retail refund exhaustion hitting restaurant/retail spending and macro uncertainty, consumer discretionary facing margin compression with limited pricing power.

trends.name: Emerging Markets Inflation & EM Currency Volatility
trends.summary: Goldman Sachs tracking significant inflation forecast revisions across emerging markets driven by oil shocks and currency weakness. EM central banks assessing duration/severity of oil price conflict impact; monetary tightening risk if energy prices remain elevated, pressuring EM growth and FX stability.

trends.name: Retirement Savings Regulation Collapse
trends.summary: Fiduciary protection rule dies for second time, removing guardrails for retirement advisor conflicts-of-interest. Negative signal for compliance-heavy financial services and potential consumer protection gaps; impacts advisor practices and asset allocation strategies for retirement portfolios.

trends.name: Infrastructure Data Center Consolidation
trends.summary: Airtel raises $1 billion from Carlyle and PE firms for data center expansion, signaling robust institutional appetite for digital infrastructure amid AI/cloud growth. Capital flowing aggressively to telecom-backed data center plays despite broader macro uncertainty.

trends.name: Consumer Discretionary Reset & Valuation Compression
trends.summary: Nike under pressure to restore investor confidence amid competitive challenges; Lovesac downgraded on macro headwinds; Shake Shack positioned for re-rating on cash flow inflection. Consumer discretionary facing valuation reset as spending patterns normalize post-stimulus and inflation erodes margins.

trends.name: Precious Metals & Commodities Bull Case
trends.summary: Barrick Mining and vanadium miners gaining attention as structural tailwinds (inflation hedges, energy transition, geopolitical risk premium) support commodity prices. Mining sector positioning as alternative to tech-heavy equities amid recession fears and macro uncertainty.
